name: Ora Banda Mining Limited
summary: Ora Banda Mining Limited engages in mineral exploration, mining operations, mine development, and the sale of gold and gold-bearing ore in Australia. The company primarily explores for gold, nickel, and copper. The company holds 100% interest in the Davyhurst Gold Project that is located in the north-west of Kalgoorlie. The company was formerly known as Eastern Goldfields Limited and changed its name to Ora Banda Mining Limited in June 2019. Ora Banda Mining Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.
